content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge assigns UNDERDETERMINED because the text lacks explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the silence-based ground K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"single verse does not state a link or its contrary: one reading forbids using a single verse's silence to ground UNDERDETERMINED; the other would allow the silence about paternity to ground UNDERDETERMINED.","why":"The judge's reason is the absence of an explicit textual resolution, so it grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the sort of silence K-S2 forbids."}
